sql.propToolAdder.getAllForCompany: select a.id, a.adder_name, a.company_id, a.archived from props.adder a where a.company_id = :companyId and a.archived is not true order by a.adder_name
sql.propToolAdder.update: update props.adder set adder_name = :adderName where id = :id
sql.propToolAdder.delete: update props.adder set archived = true, modified_by_id = :modifiedById, date_modified = now() where id = :id
